title: Embedding quality prognostics and offline signal framework
creator: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Recent customer incidents and internal benchmarks show intermittent regressions in reranking quality after model swaps and quantization changes. We need an offline framework that can (1) produce stratified test sets representative of customer workloads, (2) compute stable, explainable signals that forecast quality regressions (prognostics) before rollout, and (3) integrate with alerting so product/ops can act quickly.
scope: Build a repeatable pipeline that creates tiered evaluation corpora (seed gold+, stratified customer slices, adversarial perturbations), runs batch embedding+rerank simulations, and emits a small set of guarded signals (pairwise AUC, normalized DCG, isotonic calibration error, percentile tail drift, latency-quality tradeoff). Wire the signals into Console (quality dashboard) and into our Alerting deck for regression gating and canary policies.
deliverables: 1) Data generator for deterministic synthetic perturbations and stratified sampling; 2) Offline runner that can replay requests with multiple model variants and quantization profiles; 3) Signal extractor with historical baselining and z-score based alerts; 4) Runbook for interpreting signals, recommended rollback thresholds, and lightweight fix actions; 5) Integration hooks: console-quality dashboard prototype and a nightly job that writes results to telemetry.
tasks: Design tiered corpus schema (gold-core, gold-edge, customer-slices, synthetic-perturb)
Implement corpus builder with reproducible seeding and seed archive
Add offline runner: batch embed -> rerank simulation -> metrics exporter
Implement signal extractor: per-slice metrics, tail percentiles, calibration check
Add historical baselineer and alert z-score logic (configurable windows)
Add Console dashboard prototype and wire nightly job to telemetry topic
Create runbook + canary gating policy and ingest into release playbooks
End-to-end tests and performance test for nightly job (target < 45m run)
acceptance_criteria: Nightly job completes on representative 100k query sample within 45 minutes in CI
Signals (AUC, nDCG@10, calibration-error, tail-drift) computed per-slice and persisted
Alerts fire in staging when synthetic perturbation increases drift z-score > 3
Console dashboard shows historical baseline and current run overlay for at least 3 slices
Runbook contains clear rollback thresholds and owner contact info
PRs for corpus-builder, offline-runner, and extractor merged and integration test green
